description:
Find the Man of Many buyer's guide for a product type and return its ranked picks.

    Use when someone asks "what's the best X" (dive watch, running shoe, espresso machine,
    cologne, whisky). Returns the best-matching guide with each pick's name, price as
    published, a short verdict and the retailer link exactly as it appears in the article,
    plus other related guides.

topic.description: The product type to find a buyer's guide for, e.g. "dive watches", "white sneakers", "beard trimmer", "espresso machine". Use a product category: bare brand names usually match no guide, so use search_articles for brands.
topic.title: Topic
